checks.title: maint_item_sources matches item_source_facts
checks.description: Canonical relation facts must stay row-for-row with active maint item sources.
checks.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `terria_v1_maint`.`maint_item_sources` WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0) AS maintCount,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `terria_v1_relation`.`item_source_facts` WHERE source_maint_table = 'maint_item_sources') AS relationCount,
  ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `terria_v1_maint`.`maint_item_sources` WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `terria_v1_relation`.`item_source_facts` WHERE source_maint_table = 'maint_item_sources')) AS delta

checks.title: maint_item_sources keys missing from item_source_facts
checks.description: Every active maint item source record_key must be present in relation item source facts.
checks.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM `terria_v1_maint`.`maint_item_sources` m
LEFT JOIN `terria_v1_relation`.`item_source_facts` f
  ON f.source_maint_table = 'maint_item_sources'
 AND BINARY f.source_maint_record_key = BINARY m.record_key
WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0
  AND f.record_key IS NULL

checks.title: item_source_facts keys missing from maint_item_sources
checks.description: Relation item source facts must remain traceable to active maint item sources.
checks.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM `terria_v1_relation`.`item_source_facts` f
LEFT JOIN `terria_v1_maint`.`maint_item_sources` m
  ON f.source_maint_table = 'maint_item_sources'
 AND BINARY m.record_key = BINARY f.source_maint_record_key
 AND m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN `terria_v1_maint`.`maint_npc_crawler_facts` n
  ON f.source_maint_table = 'maint_npc_crawler_facts'
 AND BINARY n.record_key = BINARY f.source_maint_record_key
 AND n.status = 1
 AND n.deleted = 0
WHERE f.source_maint_record_key IS NULL
   OR f.source_maint_table NOT IN ('maint_item_sources', 'maint_npc_crawler_facts')
   OR (f.source_maint_table = 'maint_item_sources' AND m.record_key IS NULL)
   OR (f.source_maint_table = 'maint_npc_crawler_facts' AND n.record_key IS NULL)

checks.title: maint-owned backfill candidate breakdown
checks.description: Maint remains the owner of crawler/backfill candidate queue state.
checks.sql:

  domain,
  missing_field AS missingField,
  recommended_action AS recommendedAction,

checks.title: latest relation sync exportable report rows
checks.description: Relation sync exports unresolved/candidate evidence through reports, not maint_backfill_candidates writes.
checks.sql:
SELECT
  rr.report_kind AS reportKind,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  MAX(rr.report_path) AS latestReportPath
FROM `terria_v1_relation`.`relation_run_reports` rr
INNER JOIN `terria_v1_relation`.`relation_runs` r
  ON r.run_key = rr.run_key
WHERE r.id = (
  SELECT MAX(id)
  FROM `terria_v1_relation`.`relation_runs`
  WHERE status = 'succeeded'
)
  AND rr.report_kind IN ('audit_json', 'audit_md', 'conflicts_json', 'unresolved_json')
GROUP BY rr.report_kind
ORDER BY rr.report_kind

checks.title: local compatibility npc_shop_conditions rows
checks.description: Local shop condition rows should match the projected shop-entry joins produced from relation rows that carry condition fields.
checks.sql:
SELECT
  expected.expectedCount,
  local.localCount,
  expected.expectedCount - local.localCount AS delta
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS expectedCount
  FROM `terria_v1_relation`.`item_npc_shop_relations` r
  INNER JOIN `terria_v1_relation`.`item_source_facts` f
    ON f.record_key = r.source_fact_key
  INNER JOIN `terria_v1_local`.`npcs` n
    ON n.internal_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = r.npc_internal_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
   AND n.deleted = 0
   AND n.status = 1
  INNER JOIN `terria_v1_local`.`items` i
    ON i.internal_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = r.item_internal_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
   AND i.deleted = 0
   AND i.status = 1
  INNER JOIN `terria_v1_local`.`npc_shop_entries` se
    ON se.npc_id = n.id
   AND (se.item_id <=> i.id)
   AND (se.price_text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci <=> r.price_text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci)
  WHERE r.deleted = 0
    AND r.status = 1
    AND r.review_status IN ('accepted', 'resolved', 'promoted')
    AND f.deleted = 0
    AND f.status = 1
    AND f.review_status IN ('accepted', 'resolved', 'promoted')
    AND (r.condition_events_json IS NOT NULL OR r.special_flags_json IS NOT NULL OR r.condition_source_text IS NOT NULL)
) expected
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS localCount
  FROM `terria_v1_local`.`npc_shop_conditions`
) local
